title: Thanks for helping at our place
welcome: Thank you for looking after everyone while we're away!
Sign up for the days you can come, and tap **Done** on a task when you've done it so the next person knows.

who.title: Meet the crew

items.name: Biscuit
items.subtitle: Dog, 4 years
items.about: Golden mix. Very friendly, a little shy with new people for the first five minutes.
items.tip: Pulls on the leash when he sees squirrels. Stop and wait until he looks back at you.

items.name: Pepper
items.subtitle: Cat, 7 years
items.about: Grey tabby. Mostly hides under the bed and comes out once it's quiet.

items.name: The plants
items.subtitle: Living room and porch
items.about: Ferns by the window, herbs on the porch, a big monstera in the corner.

who.note: 🐾 Everyone gets along. Biscuit and Pepper can be in the same room.

visit.title: What a visit involves

steps.text: Feed Biscuit and Pepper: one scoop each.

steps: Take Biscuit for a 20-minute walk around the block.
Check the tasks below (water bowls, litter, plants) and tap **Done** on any you do.
Lock up and put the key back in the lockbox.

info.label: Getting in
lines: Key is in the lockbox by the garage
info.highlight: We'll text you the lockbox code.

info.label: Leash & bags
lines: On the hook by the front door.

info.label: Emergency
lines: Vet: add your vet's name and number here

cards.title: Walking
items: Leash on before opening the door.
Short loop: left out the door, around the block (about 20 minutes).
Wipe his paws with the towel by the door when you're back.
cards.note: He'll try to eat things on the sidewalk. A firm "leave it" works.

cards.title: Playing with Pepper
items: Sit on the floor and wait; she'll come to you.
The feather wand is in the basket by the couch.

cards.title: Food
cards.subtitle: Kibble in the pantry
steps: Fill the scoop level, not heaped.
Put Pepper's bowl on the counter so Biscuit can't reach it.
cards.note: No table scraps, please. Grapes and chocolate are dangerous for dogs.

cards.title: Water
cards.subtitle: Two bowls in the kitchen
steps: Rinse both bowls with hot water.

cards.title: Litter
cards.subtitle: Litter box in the laundry room

tasks.label: Take the bag out when full

flag.text: Full now: please take it out

steps: Scoop clumps into the bag on the hook.
Tie the bag and put it in the outside trash.

video.label: How to scoop a litter box (video)
